title: Outpatient Care
hero.text: Comprehensive outpatient rehabilitation for adults, adolescents and children, bringing together multidisciplinary teams to restore function, build independence and support them throughout their recovery.

intro.heading: Outpatient Care Services
text: Our outpatient clinics bring together a holistic, multidisciplinary approach to rehabilitation. Our teams work hand in hand to design a comprehensive and personalised recovery roadmap for every patient, whether they are recovering from injury, surgery, a neurological event or a long-term condition.

With outpatient clinics in both UAE and KSA, we provide specialised therapy for patients continuing their recovery at home, as well as those who received their initial treatment elsewhere and require ongoing care.
